title: Teaching Concepting in the Wild
content: The assignment for my workshop students was to bring an action figure and a sketchbook and to meet in Parc du Canada.They brought everything from hippos to solar powered robot dogs.They did a brilliant job of enlarging them, making them flying or climbing buildings.Mayhem in Montreal, gouache and watercolor, 5 x 7 inches.Here's my demo, done in watercolor and gouache. We all had a great time, and I'm really excited by the creativity and enthusiasm of all the students.
